files.Summary: Drives relative angular velocity about an axis attached to each body.

files.Title: Jitter2.Dynamics.Constraints.BallSocket

files.Summary: Low-level data for constraints, stored in unmanaged memory.

files.Title: Jitter2.Dynamics.Constraints.DistanceLimit
files.Summary: Keeps the distance between two body anchors within a range, or at a fixed value. For a fixed distance of zero, use .

files.Title: Jitter2.Dynamics.Constraints.EllipticalConeLimit
files.Summary: Restricts relative swing to the region between two elliptical cones, leaving twist free.

files.Title: Jitter2.Dynamics.Constraints.FixedAngle
files.Summary: Preserves the relative orientation of two bodies while leaving translation free.

files.Title: Jitter2.Dynamics.Constraints.HingeAngle
files.Summary: Allows relative rotation around a single axis, with optional angular limits. Does not keep the bodies at a shared anchor; use for a complete hinge.

files.Title: Jitter2.Dynamics.Constraints.HingeJoint
files.Summary: Connects two bodies at a shared anchor, allowing relative rotation around one axis. Supports angular limits and an optional motor or servo.

files.Title: Jitter2.Dynamics.Constraints.Joint
files.Summary: Groups constraints into a joint that can be enabled, disabled, removed, or drawn as a whole.

files.Summary: Selects the optional drive created with a joint.

files.Title: Jitter2.Dynamics.Constraints.LinearAxisServo

files.Title: Jitter2.Dynamics.Constraints.LinearLimit
files.Summary: Represents a linear limit defined by a minimum and maximum distance. Used by constraints to restrict translational motion within a specified range.

files.Title: Jitter2.Dynamics.Constraints.LinearMotor
files.Summary: Drives relative linear velocity along an axis attached to each body.

files.Title: Jitter2.Dynamics.Constraints.LinearServo
files.Summary: Drives an anchor on body 2 toward a target position attached to body 1 using limited force. Controls three translational degrees of freedom; relative orientation remains free.

files.Title: Jitter2.Dynamics.Constraints.PointOnLine
files.Summary: Keeps an anchor on body 2 on a line attached to body 1, with optional limits along the line. Relative rotation remains free.

files.Title: Jitter2.Dynamics.Constraints.PointOnPlane
files.Summary: Limits an anchor on body 2 to a plane or a range of distances from a plane attached to body 1. Movement along the plane and relative rotation remain free.

files.Title: Jitter2.Dynamics.Constraints.PrismaticJoint
files.Summary: Allows two bodies to slide along an axis, with optional distance limits and a motor or servo. Relative rotation can be locked or allowed around the sliding axis.

files.Title: Jitter2.Dynamics.Constraints.SmallConstraintData
files.Summary: Low-level data for constraints that fit within bytes.

files.Title: Jitter2.Dynamics.Constraints.TwistAngle
files.Summary: Limits relative twist around axes attached to two bodies, leaving swing and translation free.

files.Title: Jitter2.Dynamics.Constraints.TwistServo
files.Summary: Drives relative twist toward a target angle using limited torque. Controls one angular degree of freedom; translation and swing remain free.

files.Title: Jitter2.Dynamics.Constraints.UniversalJoint
files.Summary: Connects two bodies at a shared anchor, allowing rotation about two axes while constraining twist. Supports an optional motor or servo.

files.Title: Jitter2.Dynamics.Constraints.WeldJoint

A structure representing a Quaternion: Q = xi + yj + z*k + w.
